title: What type of munition will be confirmed destroyed in Syria's first OPCW-verified chemical-weapons destruction operation since 2014?
background: The Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons (OPCW) verifies the destruction of chemical weapons and associated munitions.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the type of munition identified as destroyed in Syria's first OPCW-verified chemical-munitions destruction operation since 2014, as reported to the UN Security Council by 2026-09-03.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-09-03
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the specific munition type, excluding its quantity.

title: Which country will win the men's team gymnastics gold medal at the 2026 Commonwealth Games?
background: The Commonwealth Games men's team gymnastics competition awards medals according to the final team standings.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Commonwealth Games results, corroborated by contemporary reliable news reporting.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the country awarded gold in the men's team gymnastics competition at the 2026 Commonwealth Games, once the final standings are announced.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the winning country.

title: Which Southeast Asian country will announce a finalized voluntary repatriation plan for thousands of Myanmar refugees in August 2026?
background: Repatriation means returning refugees to their country of origin. This question concerns finalization of a government plan, rather than the completion of refugee returns.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official government statements or reliable news reporting directly quoting those statements.
  • Resolving Event: During August 2026, a Southeast Asian government publicly confirms that it has finalized a voluntary repatriation programme, or the first phase of such a programme, covering at least 1,000 refugees from Myanmar. A preliminary agreement to consider returns is insufficient. Actual departures need not have occurred.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The common English name of the country finalizing the repatriation plan, not the destination country.

title: Which Federal Reserve policymakers will vote for an interest-rate increase at the July 29, 2026 FOMC meeting?
background: The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) sets US monetary policy. Its policy announcements disclose members' votes and the policy preferences of dissenting voters.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The Federal Reserve's official policy statement and voting record for the meeting concluding July 29, 2026, corroborated by contemporaneous news reporting.
  • Resolution: Identify every voting member whose recorded position favors increasing the federal funds target range relative to the range immediately before the meeting. Include those members whether an increase is adopted or they dissent in favor of one.
  • Accepted Answer Format: All qualifying members' surnames, listed alphabetically and separated by commas.
last_rationale: June payrolls +57k; Warsh softer; Sept hike ~65%

title: Which candidate will receive the most “encourage” votes in the first UN Security Council straw poll of the 2026 secretary-general selection?
background: António Guterres is serving as UN secretary-general. Informal Security Council straw polls gauge support for potential successors, with members indicating whether they encourage, discourage or have no opinion on each candidate.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official UN information or contemporaneous reporting by reputable international news organizations describing the first Security Council straw poll in the 2026 secretary-general selection process.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the candidate receiving the highest number of “encourage” votes in that first poll, regardless of subsequent polls or the final appointment.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The candidate’s full name.
last_rationale: encourage votes; Bachelet may get many encourages despite US

title: Which European country will announce plans to shut down its only nuclear power plant because of drought-related cooling-water shortages by August 2, 2026?
background: Nuclear power plants that use river water for cooling can face operational restrictions when drought reduces the available water supply.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official government statements or contemporaneous reporting by established news organizations.
  • Resolution Rule: Identify the European country whose government announces, between July 1 and August 2, 2026, inclusive, plans for a complete shutdown of its sole operating nuclear power plant because drought has reduced the river water available for reactor cooling. The announcement of the shutdown plan is sufficient; the shutdown itself need not have occurred. A partial reduction in electricity output alone does not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's commonly used English name.
last_rationale: lesson: trim concentration; Romania still strong (Danube 30-50%)

title: Who will top the men's javelin throw qualification standings at the 2026 Commonwealth Games?
background: The men's javelin throw competition includes a qualifying round before the final.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Games results for the overall men's javelin throw qualification at the 2026 Commonwealth Games
  • Resolution Date: July 30, 2026
  • Accepted Answer Format: Full name of the athlete ranked first in the overall men's javelin throw qualification results

title: Who will win the men's javelin throw gold medal at the 2026 Commonwealth Games?
background: The 2026 Commonwealth Games are scheduled to take place in Glasgow, Scotland.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Commonwealth Games results or reliable contemporaneous reporting identifying the gold medallist in the 2026 men's javelin throw final.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the athlete declared the gold medallist at the conclusion of the final. Subsequent medal reallocations will not affect resolution.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The gold medallist's full name.

title: If the Detroit Tigers trade Tarik Skubal by the 2026 MLB trade deadline, which team will acquire him?
background: Tarik Skubal is a starting pitcher for the Detroit Tigers and is eligible for free agency after the 2026 season.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official MLB or team announcements, or confirmed reporting from ESPN, identifying a completed trade of Tarik Skubal by the 2026 MLB trade deadline.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the MLB club acquiring Skubal directly from the Detroit Tigers. If no such trade occurs by the deadline, the question is void.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The acquiring club's full team name.

title: Who will win the 2026 Rocket Classic on the PGA Tour?
background: The Rocket Classic is a men's professional golf tournament on the PGA Tour.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The PGA Tour's official final results for the 2026 Rocket Classic.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the golfer officially declared the tournament winner following the final round and any playoff required to determine the champion.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning golfer's full name.

title: Who will win the men's singles title at the 2026 Mubadala DC Open?
background: The Mubadala DC Open is a professional tennis tournament in Washington, D.C. Its men's singles competition is part of the ATP Tour.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The official ATP results for the 2026 Mubadala DC Open.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the player officially recorded as the men's singles champion once the tournament final is completed and the result is confirmed.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The champion's full name.

title: Who will win the women's singles title at the 2026 Mubadala DC Open?
background: The Mubadala DC Open is a professional tennis tournament in Washington, D.C. Its women's singles competition is part of the WTA Tour.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The official WTA results for the 2026 Mubadala DC Open.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the player officially recorded as the women's singles champion once the tournament final is completed and the result is confirmed.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The champion's full name.

title: Which country will agree to a joint project with Iran to clear sea mines from the Strait of Hormuz by August 26, 2026?
background: Sea mines have been reported near the Strait of Hormuz, a major route for international oil and gas shipments.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the country that agrees with Iran to a joint mine-clearance project in the Strait of Hormuz, as announced in a statement from the two governments by August 26, 2026.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-08-26
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the country's common English name.

title: What sentence will Egyptian television presenter Sarah Khalifa receive at trial in her drug-trafficking case?
background: Sarah Khalifa was arrested in Egypt in April 2025 as part of a drug investigation.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The trial court’s announced judgment in the drug-trafficking prosecution stemming from Khalifa’s April 2025 arrest, as confirmed by official court information or reliable reporting from Al-Ahram.
  • Resolution Timing: Resolve when the trial court announces its verdict and sentence. Later appellate decisions and judgments in unrelated cases do not count.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Provide a short legal term identifying the principal penalty imposed, or the court’s disposition if no penalty is imposed. If multiple penalties are imposed, report the most severe.

title: Which university will house Raja Shehadeh's personal diary archive by August 31, 2026?
background: Raja Shehadeh is a Palestinian writer and lawyer who has kept personal diaries since 1967.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the university confirmed to be physically holding Shehadeh's original personal diary archive by August 31, 2026. Confirmation must come from public statements by Shehadeh or the receiving university, or contemporaneous news reporting establishing that the archive has arrived, rather than merely announcing a planned transfer.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-08-31
  • Accepted Answer Format: string (institution). Answer with the university's name.

title: Which prominent RSF field commander will Darfur's governor announce has been killed in western Sudan in early August 2026?
background: The Rapid Support Forces (RSF) are a paramilitary group fighting Sudan's army in a war that began in April 2023.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the RSF field commander whose death in fighting in western Sudan Darfur Governor Minni Arko Minnawi announces during August 1–10, 2026, according to Al Jazeera's reporting. The question concerns the governor's announcement, not independent confirmation of the death.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-08-10 (announcement window: August 1–10, 2026)
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the commander's name, omitting military rank and nickname.

title: Who will win the Democratic nomination for U.S. Senate in Kansas in 2026?
background: Kansas will hold a U.S. Senate election in November 2026, with party nominees selected in the August primary.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Results reported by Kansas election authorities or definitive election reporting from a major news organization.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the winner of Kansas's Democratic U.S. Senate primary scheduled for August 4, 2026, once the outcome is unambiguously reported.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning candidate's full name.
last_rationale: markets split earlier; poll 18% w/ many undecided

title: Which team will win the second Test of Pakistan's 2026 tour of the West Indies?
background: Pakistan and the West Indies are scheduled to contest a two-match Test cricket series in the Caribbean.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The official match result published by the ICC or either national cricket board, corroborated by reputable contemporary match reporting.
  • Resolution: Resolve upon completion of the second Test of Pakistan's 2026 tour of the West Indies, using the final result rather than any intermediate match position.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Provide the winning national team's name. If neither team wins, provide the official result classification.

title: Who will win Michigan’s 2026 Democratic primary for U.S. Senate?
background: Michigan will elect a U.S. senator in November 2026. The Democratic primary will determine the party’s nominee for that election.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Results from Michigan election authorities or unambiguous reporting by major news organizations identifying the winner of Michigan’s 2026 Democratic primary for U.S. Senate.
  • Resolution Date: Resolve when the winner of the primary, scheduled for August 4, 2026, is publicly established.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning candidate’s name.
